intent: Critical diagnostic, international payment and Crypto platform domains must not be reclassified DIRECT in staged upstream rules. Static protection only: not a guarantee of correct routing for every service, shared CDN or IP-only target.
source_issue: Repeated upstream misclassification: ChinaMaxNoMedia_Domain included .browserleaks.com and .whatismyip.com; ChinaMaxNoMedia.list included broad DOMAIN-KEYWORD,stripe.
review: Treat every new DIRECT keyword and non-CN diagnostic/payment domain as a candidate for explicit policy review. Run all emitted-list CI tests and validate on-device before enabling composites.
